connection_condition: a card printing references its set through the set's short code; set metadata is stored per code and card printings carry that code
description: A card set is composed of its card printings; a card printing belongs to exactly one set and has no meaning outside a set.

connection_condition: each localized set name is stored against the set's short code and a language
description: A set's localized names are components of the set's identity; a localized name cannot exist without the set it translates.

connection_condition: a legality record references the card printing by its uuid
description: Legality verdicts are components of a card printing's record; a verdict has no meaning without the card printing it evaluates.

connection_condition: a ruling references the card by its uuid
description: Rulings are attached to a card identity; a ruling cannot exist independently of the card it clarifies.

connection_condition: a foreign-language record references the card printing by its uuid and adds a language
description: A localized card name is a component of the foreign-language representation of a card printing.

connection_condition: a foreign-language record references the card printing by its uuid and adds a language
description: The translated rules text is a component of the foreign-language representation of a card printing.

connection_condition: a foreign-language record references the card printing by its uuid and adds a language
description: The translated flavor text is a component of the foreign-language representation of a card printing.
Converted mana cost is derived from the card's mana cost by totalling the mana symbols into a single numeric value; both representations are stored per card printing.
A share percentage is derived from two counts over the same population of card printings: the subset satisfying the stated condition and the reference population.
The canonical set name and the marketplace set name express the same business concept of a set's name from two providers; one may be populated where the other is empty.
The canonical English set name and a localized set name are the same concept of a set's name in different languages, and are linked through the set's short code rather than by text equality.
The canonical card name and the foreign card name both express the name of the same card; they differ by language and are linked through the card's uuid rather than by text equality.

connection_condition: both are attributes of the same set record
description: A set's short code and its canonical name are two identifiers of the same set; the code is the stable link key while the name is the human-readable label.
A set is grouped under a block or product line; many sets have no block value.
A set's availability on Magic: The Gathering Online is an attribute of the set, recorded by the presence of an MTGO code.
Every legality verdict is scoped to exactly one named play format.
Every legality record carries exactly one verdict drawn from the status value domain.
Translated card text is only meaningful together with the language it is written in; language and text are stored on the same foreign-language record.
Rarity is an attribute of a card printing, so the same card name may carry different rarities across its printings.
Power is an attribute of a creature card printing and is absent for non-creatures.
Border treatment is an attribute of a card printing.
The credited artist is an attribute of a card printing, so the same card name may credit different artists across printings.
The content warning flag qualifies the data completeness of a card printing's own properties and values.
The story spotlight flag marks card printings belonging to a set's story sequence.
The EDHRec popularity rank is an attribute of a card printing.
The originally printed type line is an attribute of a card printing and may disagree with the modern type and subtype fields.
